behavior: Business loads all four collections as one validated result, retains prior records on failure, hides counters/forms during loading or error and offers retry.
Business rejects malformed records, unsafe/negative/blank/boolean expense amounts and invalid dates before totals can be shown.
Monthly expense totals match both local-calendar month and year; same-month prior-year regression covered.
Confirmed stale-response races in Estimates, Invoices, Agreements, Follow-ups and Payments fixed; only latest request may commit rows, error or loading state. Unmount invalidates reads.

Standalone validator and merge-only restore accept optional payment_refunds, validate ownership/reservations/succeeded ledger semantics, reject duplicate identities and check preserved target refund reservations before writing.
Restore verifies inserted field values and final relationships/refund ledger; interrupted-prefix retry restores missing requests without duplicates or overwriting preserved records.
Verified older snapshots remain accepted without optional refund metadata, including historic refund ledger entries. No refund request metadata is fabricated.
testLimits: Actual component functions/hooks with mocked GET; actual in-app backup GET → standalone CLI with a local-only mocked Wrangler backed by temporary SQLite → in-app GET verification. Test schema is created only in disposable fixtures. No cloud database/resource access or real Stripe requests. Financial suites mock Stripe in memory. No hosted/mobile/sandbox integration proof.
recoveryLimits: Run operational restores against a quiescent, fully compatible schema; this batch does not prove cloud concurrency or authorize restore execution. Existing records win; immutable conflicts fail for review. Photo files require a separate archive and are not restored by the records CLI. Older backups without refund metadata retain the in-app compatibility rule, so ownership/ledger-to-request checks cannot be reconstructed for omitted requests.
verificationSequence: Fourteen suites per target passed; final Business amount guard was subsequently rechecked through loader suite, TypeScript and builds on all targets. The final legacy-ledger compatibility regression reran the records recovery suite on all targets. Unchanged suites were not repeated.
priorManifest: Historical manifests, evidence and rollback copies preserved; none seals the new source. No release/deployment approval implied.
overnightRuns: Stopped; this handoff does not restart automations or background work.
